research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Grailed is developing a system and method for verifying consumer items titled “System and method for verifying consumer items.” The abstract describes a computer platform for a selling user to list fashion and lifestyle items while multiple experts review and verify authenticity, with items queued in a management system for expert access. This work focuses on expert-driven authenticity verification and queue-based listing management.
